crons.comment: Poll feed sources. Cadence is per source in the database; this is the outer tick.

Match what the poll did not: pasted pages, captured URLs and mailbox alerts arrive with no item, and a listing with no item can never be scored. Between the poll and the alert, so anything matched here is scoreable by the time the alert reads it.
Score and alert, straight after the poll so latency stays small.
Attention signals. Daily is what the source publishes; asking more often returns the same numbers.
